headline: Jamie Dimon launches cross-industry AI risk alliance
body: A quiet day with one story. JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon is expanding the Alliance for Critical Infrastructure into a 40-plus organisation effort with the US government to anticipate AI risks. That gives Alignment & Control a small boost, lifting Protector God and easing Conquerors. Horizon Balance improved to -1.40.
movers_note: Protector God +0.1 and Conquerors -0.1 came from the Dimon alliance (+0.10 and -0.10).
